diagnosis: The smart meter time-series endpoint fetches a GridDB container directly by meterId without checking whether the meter belongs to req.user.householdId. Authenticated utility customers can supply meter IDs belonging to other residences to view detailed power consumption readings, revealing whether occupants are currently home.
exploit_request:
GET /api/meters/meter_austin_res_40912/series HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.smartpower-utility.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Accept: application/json
